blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis Pangilinan on Monday urged the Philippine National Police (PNP) to exercise maximum tolerance during protests to demonstrate its commitment to protecting free speech. This comes after more than 300 protesters preparing to march to the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC), the venue of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit, were arrested on Sunday, with some reportedly ending up unconscious. “We encourage the Philippine National Police to exercise maximum tolerance and respect the right of every Filipino to assemble peacefully and freely express their views,” Pangilinan said in a statement.
